metaTitle: Custom Raglan Baseball Sweaters | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom raglan baseball sweaters and cardigans for your team. Bulk orders with free setup at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Raglan baseball sweaters and cardigans combine the classic raglan sleeve design with a polished knit look, making them a favorite for corporate teams and events. The raglan cut allows for greater range of motion, ideal for staff who need both comfort and a professional appearance. These sweaters work well for outdoor giveaways, trade show staff uniforms, or company retreats. Choose from cotton blends or wool-acrylic mixes and add your logo with embroidery or screen printing for a clean, durable finish.
